title: Dinosaur dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='34' ry='5' fill='#2a3f5f'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 72 Q14 74 8 60 Q20 66 30 64 Z' fill='#3fbf6f'/>
  <path d='M30 72 Q18 73 12 63 Q22 67 30 66 Z' fill='#59d98a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='64' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#45c877'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='60' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#7fe9a5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f5e27a'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d='M38 76 Q36 86 32 89 Q36 91 40 89 L42 79 Z' fill='#2f9e57'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#2f9e57'/>
  <!-- front leg (raised, dancing) -->
  <path d='M58 70 Q66 72 70 64 Q72 60 68 58 Q64 62 60 62 Z' fill='#45c877'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='59' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#7fe9a5' transform='rotate(-25 70 59)'/>
  <!-- other leg planted -->
  <path d='M52 78 Q54 86 56 89 Q60 90 61 87 L57 78 Z' fill='#45c877'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='89' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#7fe9a5'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M54 52 Q56 42 60 36 L68 40 Q62 48 62 54 Z' fill='#45c877'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='33' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#45c877'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='30' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#7fe9a5'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='37' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#59d98a'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M74 39 Q78 43 82 39' stroke='#1e6e3c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='2.4' fill='#123a24'/>
  <circle cx='70.8' cy='29.2' r='0.9' fill='#e9fff2'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='37' r='2' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M42 49 L46 42 L50 50 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <path d='M50 45 L54 38 L58 46 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <path d='M34 56 L36 49 L41 55 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- raised arm front -->
  <path d='M60 56 Q70 52 74 46 Q76 50 72 54 Q66 60 60 60 Z' fill='#45c877'/>
  <!-- sparkles around dancing -->
  <path d='M22 40 L24 44 L28 45 L24 46 L22 50 L20 46 L16 45 L20 44 Z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <path d='M84 68 L85.5 71 L88.5 72 L85.5 73 L84 76 L82.5 73 L79.5 72 L82.5 71 Z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#9ee7ff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#9ee7ff'/>
</svg>
